correctness.rationale: Independently expanded the Möbius factors to confirm I-B_A(z)B_A(w)^*=(1-z ar w)(I-zA)^(-1)(I-A²)(I- ar w A)^(-1) for positive self-adjoint A: numerator cancellation is (1-z ar w)(I-A²). Thus the source sub-Bergman kernel is transported by invertible L_A(z)=(I-A²)^(1/2)(I-zA)^(-1), giving ||f||_sub=||L_A^(-1) f|| on weighted Bergman. For alpha>0 weighted-area integration bounds analytic operator multipliers above by H∞ norm, and normalized reproducing kernels give equality; at alpha=0 use Hardy kernels. Spectral calculus over sigma(A) subset [0,a] with a in spectrum shows sup multipliers L_A and L_A^(-1) both equal sqrt((1+a)/(1-a)), attained as boundary z->1 and z->-1 respectively (spectral limit if a not an eigenvalue). Checked scalar endpoint expressions at a=0,.2,.75,.99 and sqrt7 at a=.75. The focal source kernel is an explicit algebraic identity; full focal text unavailability is a provenance risk, not an unchecked mathematical hypothesis.
